title: Vulnerability Assessment and Pen-testing Intern
description:
As a Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Tester Intern at ARM Innovations, you'll help assess applications, devices, and networks, turning security findings into clear, practical recommendations. You'll work with established testing tools and methods while building hands-on experience across vulnerability assessment and software security.

1. Assist with vulnerability assessments of web applications, mobile apps, and network environments under guidance.  
2. Use Burp Suite, Nmap, Kali Linux, and other security tools to investigate potential weaknesses and validate findings safely.  
3. Test web applications against relevant OWASP Top 10 risks and document reproducible steps and evidence.  
4. Support Android and iOS security testing, checking for issues such as insecure data storage, weak communication protections, and misconfigured permissions.  
5. Help review network security controls and identify exposed services, configuration gaps, and vulnerabilities for further investigation.  
6. Contribute to cloud security assessments by checking configurations and recording potential risks within the assigned scope.  
7. Track findings through the vulnerability management process, prepare clear reports, and retest fixes to confirm whether issues have been resolved.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
